articles.summary: Back-to-school isn't just about syllabi and dorm snacks—it's about setting yourself up for everything the semester throws at you. Whether you're running across campus, cramming at the library, or heading home for fall break, these picks bring smart design, real style, and plenty of personality. These are the best backpacks for college, plus a few ride-or-die extras you'll be glad to have on hand. Designed to Handle Full Schedules: The XL Bancroft Backpack If you're hauling textbooks, a laptop, snacks, and maybe a change of clothes for PE, the XL Bancroft Backpack has your back…literally. With three spacious compartments, expandable water bottle pockets, and a compartment that fits a laptop up to 17", it's built for long days on campus and longer nights in the library. Bonus: Its trolley sleeve makes heading home for the weekend a breeze. "This backpack is no only beautiful but it's large enough to fit everything without bulging out." ~ Lesli Dimensions: 12.0" w x 16.75" h x 10.0" dWeight: 2.09 lbCapacity: 38 L Smart Enough for Any Class.
